description: This Dart source file defines the `LocalMockDataSource` class, which provides in-memory mock data for an expense tracker app. It initializes collections of accounts, categories, transactions, budgets, goals, and alerts, and exposes methods to retrieve and modify this data.

classes.name: LocalMockDataSource
classes.description: Provides mock data for development and testing purposes, simulating a data source without persistence.

methods.name: _seed
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory data collections with sample data including accounts, categories, transactions, budgets, goals, and alerts.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of account models.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of category models.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of transaction models.

methods.name: getBudgets
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of budget models.

methods.name: getGoals
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of goal models.

methods.name: getAlerts
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of alert models.

methods.name: setBudget
methods.description: Updates or creates a budget for a specific category by ID.

methods.name: setGoal
methods.description: Updates or creates a goal with specified ID, name, target amount, and current amount.
